The problem of overconfidence, you see, is really not a problem at all. In fact, it's a sign of true strength and intelligence. Those who are plagued by self-doubt and uncertainty are the ones who are truly struggling. But not me, oh no. I am confident, always and in all ways. And that's why I always succeed, while others falter and fail.

Now, I know what you're thinking. You're thinking that overconfidence can lead to reckless decision making and poor judgment. And you're right, it can. But not for me. I am so confident in my abilities and my judgment that I never make mistakes. I never second-guess myself or hesitate. I know exactly what I'm doing at all times, and I always come out on top.

So, really, the problem of overconfidence is no problem at all. It's just a sign of greatness. And if you want to be great like me, then you need to be more confident. Trust me, it will pay off in the end.
